verdict.rationale: The only engine-level override documented is `--no-prerouter` / `--no-lora`, which turns off the predictive expert router and the adapters to run the plain base model. Everything else, including SSD expert streaming and tier selection, is presented as automatic defaults. missing for 10: any documented memory-locking (mlock) control, mmap toggles, tunables for expert-offload or cache size, or a general engine configuration reference.
